# HUEMAN — The Daily Color Game

> HUEMAN is a free daily color game — like Wordle, but for your eyes. One new puzzle every day at midnight UTC, identical for every player on Earth. Tap the tile with the slightly different shade (the odd one out) before the timer runs out. Each level the color difference gets smaller, the grid gets bigger, and the clock gets shorter. Three lives; your final level is your score, shareable as a Wordle-style emoji grid.

Play free in any browser, no download or signup: https://huemangame.com

## Key facts

- One puzzle per day, deterministic and identical worldwide; resets at midnight UTC (puzzle #1 was 2026-06-11).
- Gameplay: spot the odd shade in a grid that grows from 2×2 to 6×6 while the color difference shrinks and the per-level timer drops from ~12 seconds toward a 5-second floor.
- A wrong tap or running out of time costs a life; players have three lives.
- The daily puzzle is free with no account and no signup, supported by ads. There are two daily leaderboards: the Daily board ranks every player's first run (three lives, standard clock) and is frozen once filed — nothing purchasable can add or move a row on it. The Unlimited board ranks each player's best run of the day, and free players are entered on it automatically with their single run, so a player who never pays can still finish first. Optional credits buy extra attempts at the same puzzle plus handicaps such as an extra life or a slower clock; they never make the odd shade easier to see.
- Practice rounds are limited to one free round per day. Practice uses random colors rather than the day's puzzle and is never ranked. A player wanting another ranked attempt takes an Unlimited run at the same daily puzzle instead.
- Results share as an emoji grid with level reached, total time, and estimated percentile. Sharing also produces a personalized link (https://huemangame.com/r/…) whose preview card shows the level reached and invites others to beat it; the run is encoded in the URL itself (no accounts, no database).
- Every past puzzle has a permanent page at https://huemangame.com/archive/<number> (e.g. /archive/42), with an index at https://huemangame.com/archive. Only completed UTC days are listed; the current day is never spoiled.
- HUEMAN is a game, not a medical color blindness test, and cannot diagnose color vision deficiency. Shade differences include brightness shifts so it remains playable with most types of color vision deficiency. Anyone with concerns about their color vision should see an eye care professional.
- Similar games people search for: Kuku Kube, I Love Hue, Colordle, Colorfle, Hexcodle, Wordle.
- Publisher: Puzzle Page (https://puzzlepage.app) — more daily games, plus tools to create and publish your own puzzles. HUEMAN is a Puzzle Page product (Organization → parentOrganization: Puzzle Page).
